about_the_game:
Set sail for adventure on a journey of light and discovery in Monument Valley 3, the latest beautiful chapter in the award-winning Monument Valley series. Guide Noor, a young apprentice, through a world of shifting architecture and rising tides as they seek to restore the fading light.

Defy perspective, reshape reality, and navigate a world of impossible geometry and beauty—where every movement holds a secret and every puzzle tells a story.

Experience the magic of Monument Valley 3 in the most cinematic way possible, with stunning ultrawide visuals, smooth keyboard/mouse control, and immersive gamepad support. Features all major content updates and new mechanics in this stunning evolution of Monument Valley.

A New Adventure Awaits

  • Return to the universe of Monument Valley, full of more adventure than ever before. Guide Noor in their quest through a series of mind-bending illusions and puzzles. Can you unlock the secrets of the mysterious world – and the meaning behind the Sacred Light?

  • Rotate and manipulate architecture and environment to reveal hidden paths, solve intricate and unique puzzles, sail across the world and head out on a voyage of discovery across rising waters!

  • As you sail through the world, soak in the art and world design inspired by global architecture, experimental artists and a world of personal stories, all translated into unique, impossible geometry.

Sail Through Impossibility

  • In the latest chapter in the acclaimed Monument Valley series, Monument Valley 3 takes us to brand new vistas, never seen before in the Monument Valley series. Uncover the mysteries of The Lighthouse, journey the biggest ensemble in a Monument Valley game yet, and help displaced villagers find shelter from the rising tides.

Unfold Puzzles Like Origami

  • Interact and explore a stunning world inspired by modern design, global architecture and hand-crafted, personal stories, and help Noor unlock the secrets of this ever-changing world. 

Every Update Included

  • The Full Story of Monument Valley 3 is included, with brand-new puzzles and chapters coming soon!

ustwo games are proud independent developers, best known for the award-winning Monument Valley series, Land’s End, Assemble with Care and Alba: A Wildlife Adventure.
